from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlowEntry(BaseModel):
    """An extraction of investing activities cash flow data from a single financial document."""
    registrant_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name filing the report")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the report covers")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label from the cash flow statement")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for investing activities")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount, e.g. 'thousands'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief verbatim text confirming the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flow_entries: list[InvestingCashFlowEntry]
